name: Session Manager
prompt: Session Manager / Multi-User Profile Switcher - An app that saves and restores entire desktop sessions (open apps, their positions, active documents) with one click or keyboard shortcut. Users can create profiles like "Work," "Gaming," "Creative" — each saving a different layout of running apps and settings. Instantly switch between them without manually re-opening everything. This is critical for an OS that wants to serve both productivity and entertainment workflows seamlessly, especially since the user enjoys gaming alongside general desktop use.
